web.title: 🌐 Website Development
web.simple: I build websites that look professional on all devices (phones, tablets, computers) and load quickly so visitors don't get frustrated and leave.
web.analogy: Think of it like having a 24/7 storefront or office that represents your business perfectly, even when you're asleep.

seo.simple: I make sure people can find your website when they search on Google for what you offer.

copy.analogy: Good website words work like your best salesperson, available 24/7.
